token_method: estimates (BPE-like split v2, per-language calibrated, not exact tokenizer counts)
budget_tier_meaning: Every selected window and duplicate exemplar is shown in full.

redaction.scope: redactions applied while writing pack outputs (INCIDENT.md and manifest.json); the same literal appearing in both files counts per file

limits: Evidence only: this pack shows what matched, how often, and in what order. It offers no diagnosis and no root cause.
A failure written in words no pattern matches is invisible to this pack. 'No error windows matched' means no lines matched the pattern set, not that nothing went wrong.

Near-duplicate grouping masks timestamps, numbers, hex ids, UUIDs, IPs, and quoted strings. Two different errors that differ only in a masked part share one exemplar; the byte-identical count is reported beside the total.
Token figures are estimates from the stamped method, not a vendor tokenizer count.
Window line storage is capped per run; lines past the cap are counted as dropped (window store cap), never silently lost.

The first burst of an error is windowed in full context; later bursts of the same error collapse into duplicate exemplars, and consecutive repeats inside a window collapse in place. Either way the exact occurrence count is stated in the manifest and in the Repeated lines section.

If a pack had to descend the budget tiers to fit, the manifest records which tier shipped (budget_tier) and what the tier means (budget_tier_meaning), and INCIDENT.md states the tier on its face. Lines trimmed from a window to fit are counted under windows not fitted, never silently lost.

Secret-shape redaction is exact about lengths by design: the aws-access-key shape is AKIA or ASIA plus exactly 16 characters (20 in total, the same shape GhostSlice's guard uses), so a longer or shorter look-alike is not that shape. Other provider shapes are minimum-length, and a generic assignment needs a sensitive-looking name plus a value of at least 8 characters with at least 4 distinct characters. Redaction lowers risk; it is not a guarantee that every credential form is caught.
